sources.title: 奈良場勝《江戸時代の易占書の特徴》公开学术摘要：1617/1618/1631古暦与1650–1750八卦出版体系

sources.title: 东洋运势学会山口荘令《四柱推命前编》1801文会堂与1818再刊说（后世主张）
sources.provider: Toyo Unsei Gakkai, authored article by Yamaguchi Sorei
sources.quality_notes: Explicitly says Sakurada published translated Suimeisho in 1801 with 文会堂 and reissued in 1818; supplies no identifiable 1801 original folio, colophon, physical holding or work/edition fingerprint; differs from verified Kyushu 1818 preface-year attribution. 文会堂 modern story not equated with 明胡文会堂校 in older Kanmei text.

edges_rejected_or_unproved: Prior Edo natal hexagram counting and Kanmei Isshokin commentary cannot be identified as complete Four Pillars/Ziping without source mechanical proof.
1801 Sakurada first-impression is a society article claim, unverified by original physical imprint.
Same 文会堂 characters in a modern purported Edo printing-house narrative and historical Chinese 胡文會堂校 metadata do not establish identical agents or an edition lineage.
unresolved_lineage_questions: Compare Tohoku 1705/1787 exact printed folios and chapter mechanics with original Chinese Kanmei works and Kyushu 1787 holding.
Find a verifiable original 1801 Sakurada Suimeisho copy or downgrade a confident first-print claim based on independent edition history.
Compare authenticated 1818 Suimeisho rule text with pre-1818 Japanese natal systems before asserting any transmission.
